name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acromegaly_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of acromegaly.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acromegaly.

name: patient_somatomedin_c_value_recorded_now_withunit_unit
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's insulin-like growth factor I (somatomedin C) level measured at screening, in the specified unit.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available at screening or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value of insulin-like growth factor I (somatomedin C) if recorded at the screening visit, in the specified unit.

name: upper_limit_of_normal_for_somatomedin_c_value_at_screening_withunit_unit
meaning: Numeric value representing the upper limit of normal for insulin-like growth factor I (somatomedin C) at screening, in the specified unit.
when_unknown: Set to null if the upper limit of normal is not available, not defined, or indeterminate at screening.
when_value: Set to the reference upper limit of normal for insulin-like growth factor I (somatomedin C) as defined by the laboratory at the time of screening, in the specified unit.

name: patient_has_undergone_radiotherapy_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone radiotherapy in their medical history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone radiotherapy at any point in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone radiotherapy at any point in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone radiotherapy.

name: patient_has_prior_treatment_with_other_drugs_for_acromegaly_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever received prior treatment with other drugs for acromegaly in their medical history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever received prior treatment with other drugs for acromegaly at any point in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never received prior treatment with other drugs for acromegaly at any point in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever received prior treatment with other drugs for acromegaly.

name: months_elapsed_since_patient_surgical_procedure_to_screening_in_months
meaning: Numeric value indicating the number of months elapsed from the patient's most recent surgical procedure to screening.
when_unknown: Set to null if the date of the patient's most recent surgical procedure or the date of screening is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of months that have elapsed from the patient's most recent surgical procedure to the time of screening.

name: patient_has_undergone_surgical_procedure_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone a surgical procedure in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone a surgical procedure at any time in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone a surgical procedure at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone a surgical procedure.

name: patient_has_other_condition_now

when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has any other condition aside from acromegaly.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have any other condition aside from acromegaly.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has any other condition aside from acromegaly.

name: patient_has_other_condition_now@@may_result_in_abnormal_growth_hormone_concentration
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has any other condition (aside from acromegaly) that may result in abnormal growth hormone concentrations.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has any other condition (aside from acromegaly) that may result in abnormal growth hormone concentrations.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has any other condition (aside from acromegaly) that does not result in abnormal growth hormone concentrations.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's other condition (aside from acromegaly) may result in abnormal growth hormone concentrations.

name: aspartate_aminotransferase_value_recorded_now_withunit_u_per_l
meaning: Numeric value of the patient's aspartate aminotransferase (AST) measured now, in U/L.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's aspartate aminotransferase (AST) value measured now is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's aspartate aminotransferase (AST) measured now, in U/L.

name: upper_limit_of_normal_for_aspartate_aminotransferase_value_withunit_u_per_l

when_unknown: Set to null if the upper limit of normal for aspartate aminotransferase (AST) is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value representing the upper limit of normal for aspartate aminotransferase (AST), in U/L, according to the laboratory reference range.
